lines.text: David exalts the LORD for lifting him up, healing him, and pulling him up from Sheol.
David tells the saints to sing, because the LORD's anger is fleeting, His favor lasts a lifetime, and joy comes in the morning.
In the wilderness David said he would never be shaken, but he was dismayed when the LORD hid His face.
David begged the LORD for mercy and asked whether the dust would praise Him, and he asked the LORD to be his helper.
The LORD turned David's mourning into dancing and clothed him with armor, so David will give thanks forever.
